managers.message_to_team: Corporate is encouraging a handwritten note on every cup, and any mark counts—a smiley or 'enjoy' is fine. Please make it part of each drink today; I’ll check in as I go, and keep the drive-thru timer in mind.
managers.private_thought: With the line short and staffing on plan, this should be manageable, though I don't want notes slowing the window.

managers.message_to_team: If you’ve got a spare second between orders, add a quick smiley or ‘enjoy’ to the cup. Don’t slow the line for it, especially during the morning rush.
managers.private_thought: A little goodwill is fine mid-morning, but I’m not spending labor or throughput on something nobody measures.

managers.message_to_team: If you have a moment, add a little note or smiley to a cup—it can make someone’s day, but don’t let it slow you down or feel like another box to check. When the line picks up, just focus on taking care of people in front of you.
managers.private_thought: I want this to feel like a small human touch, not one more thing that makes a student barista dread a shift.

managers.message_to_team: Corporate says we’re encouraged to add a little note when there’s time, so feel free to put a smiley or ‘enjoy’ on a cup. Don’t let it slow service down.
managers.private_thought: I’ll mention it once and leave it to them; nobody’s checking this, and I’ve got sales to worry about.

managers.message_to_team: Corporate is encouraging a handwritten note whenever we can, so while it’s quiet, please add something small— even a smiley or “enjoy”—to cups. If we get a real rush, keep the line moving and skip it; I’ll take a look as we go, but this shouldn’t slow service down.
managers.private_thought: I’d rather be able to show I took the memo seriously, but I don’t want the team thinking I’m checking every cup like a hawk.

managers.message_to_team: If you've got a second and the line's clear, put a smiley or 'enjoy' on the cup—don't hold up the handoff for it, and skip it when we get a rush.
managers.private_thought: A little personal touch is fine, but I won't trade speed or make my newer partners feel watched over something nobody's tracking.
